correctness.rationale: The claim covers every planar SPD Q, deterministic start, and two *sequential exact* line minimizations. Whitening Q reduces one step to a Euclidean rank-one projection; integrating over angle gives independent-pair D and orthogonal-pair C, with C=((κ−1)/(κ+1))²D as full matrices (not isotropically averaged starts). An independent midpoint quadrature with 100,000 angles at κ=1,1.2,2,4,9,49 reproduced the entire matrix identity to <3e−8. Partial-fraction/angular formulas in RESULT.md establish it for continuum κ; κ=1 handled separately.
residual_risks: Finite independent experiments corroborate selected identities only; universal assertions depend on reconstructed proof, not experiments.
